lines.en: With justice he reins in [the Britons], and with iron and close-fastened bars

lines.orig: Occlusit belli portas super arma triumphans,
lines.en: he has barred the gates of war, triumphing over arms

loci.virgil: saeva sedens super arma, et centum vinctus aenis

lines.en: and over the Ocean too; whose broad waters gleam back

loci.virgil: cui neque apud Danaos usquam locus, et super ipsi
Ucalegon; Sigea igni freta lata relucent.

lines.orig: Fulgure sulphureo, & tonitru trepida unda remugit;
lines.en: with sulphurous lightning, and the trembling wave bellows again with thunder;

lines.orig: Cujus saepe fragor stagnis auditur avernis.
lines.en: whose crash is often heard in the pools of Avernus.

loci.virgil: foedera, terque fragor stagnis auditus Avernis.

lines.orig: Illi Neptunus domitor maris, omnia jura,
lines.en: To him Neptune, tamer of the sea, yielded all authority,

loci.virgil: Tum Saturnius haec domitor maris edidit alti:

lines.orig: Et Pelagi imperium cessit, saevumque tridentem.
lines.en: the sovereignty of the deep, and his fierce trident.

loci.virgil: Aeneas classem et pelagi petere alta parabat,
non illi imperium pelagi saevumque tridentem,

lines.orig: Amplius haud terret Triton freta caerula concha
lines.en: No longer does Triton terrify the blue straits with his conch.

loci.virgil: Hunc vehit immanis Triton et caerula concha

lines.en: The Nymphs who watch over the sea and the rivers marvel;

lines.en: Thetis and Melite marvel at men’s shields gleaming far

loci.virgil: miratur nemus insuetum fulgentia longe

lines.en: across the deep, and at such great ships afloat;

loci.virgil: scuta virum fluvio pictasque innare carinas.
scuta virum fluvio pictasque innare carinas.

lines.orig: Dum nostra Oceani classis perlabitur undas,
lines.en: while our fleet glides over the waves of the Ocean,

loci.virgil: atque rotis summas levibus perlabitur undas.

lines.en: and by leave of father Neptune is borne on undaunted.

lines.en: England, as I flourished in the pursuits of unglorious ease.

lines.en: Pierian Muses, you shall dedicate this tribute to Christ—

loci.virgil: Pierides; vos haec facietis maxima Gallo—

lines.en: to Christ, my love for whom grows so greatly from hour to hour,

loci.virgil: Gallo, cuius amor tantum mihi crescit in horas,

lines.orig: Quantum vere novo viridis se subjicit alnus:
lines.en: as the green alder shoots up in the new spring:

loci.virgil: quantum vere novo viridis se subicit alnus.

lines.en: O Christ, ornament of heaven, O Christ, glory of the earth,

lines.en: keeper of a lovely flock, himself lovelier still,

lines.en: let the flock give you no cause for shame, divine Master;

loci.virgil: nec te poeniteat pecoris, divine poeta;—

lines.en: Be gracious—O, be propitious to your own—and do not forever withdraw

lines.en: yourself from our sight; may it be granted us once more to behold your face,
